units: <cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 28:7">Kel. XXVIII, 7</cite>; <cite ref="Shabbat 29a:2">Sabb. 29ᵃ</cite> <he>שלש על … חוץ מן המ׳</he> the measure of three square handbreadths of which the Rabbis speak, means exclusive of the portion used for hemming.
<cite ref="Moed Katan 26b:2">M. Kat. 26ᵇ</cite> <he>הקורע … מתוך המ׳</he> he who rends his garment only as far as the hem goes; Y. ib. III, 83ᵇ top <he>מן המ׳</he>.—Denom.:
